title.zh: Diane Pernet：时尚电影不必被分进格子
title.en: Diane Pernet on the Case for Fewer Categories

summary.zh: ASVOFF 创办人 Diane Pernet 谈这一届的评委、亚洲电影，以及她为何在考虑重新安排电影节的单元。
summary.en: The ASVOFF founder talks to C33 about her jury, Asian filmmakers and why she is reconsidering the festival’s categories.

body.zh:
在 ASVOFF 第 18 届开幕期间，C33 与创办人 Diane Pernet 谈了评委阵容。Stephen Jones、Mr. Pearl 与 Julian Klausner 来自不同的创作背景；Pernet 看重的正是这种差异。她希望评委能带来各自的观看经验，而不是用一套固定标准判断影片。

谈到亚洲创作者，Pernet 回想起电影节在蓬皮杜中心举办的时期，也提到与中国电影人的合作。现在，亚洲导演既会投稿专门单元，也会直接进入官方选片。她开始思考，是否还需要把这些作品分开：电影已经在跨越地域与类型的边界，电影节的分类也值得重新审视。她说这仍是一个正在考虑的问题，并非已确定的改制。

这一届的节目从纪录片、Future Vintage 圆桌讨论，到时尚与心理健康单元，方向并不单一。Pernet 特别看重学生作品的新鲜视角，也愿意让新秀与有经验的创作者出现在同一个节目中。对她而言，重要的是让有话要说的人获得银幕与观众。

[ASVOFF 18 官方网站](https://www.ashadedviewonfashionfilm.com/asvoff-18)
body.en:
On the opening night of ASVOFF 18, C33 asked founder Diane Pernet what she wanted from this year’s jury. Stephen Jones, Mr. Pearl and Julian Klausner bring different histories to the table; that range is the point. Pernet is interested in how people from different disciplines and generations watch a film, rather than in a single set of criteria.

The conversation turned to Asian filmmakers. Pernet recalled the festival’s years at the Centre Pompidou and her early work with Chinese films. Some directors now submit to a dedicated Chinese programme; others enter the official selection directly. She is wondering whether certain divisions still serve the films. It is an idea under consideration, not an announced change to the festival.

ASVOFF’s programme makes room for documentaries, daily talks, Future Vintage and work addressing mental health in fashion. Pernet values the fresh eye of student filmmakers and likes placing emerging voices alongside established figures. The common thread is less a genre than the willingness to give someone with something to say a screen.

[ASVOFF 18 official website](https://www.ashadedviewonfashionfilm.com/asvoff-18)

title.zh: Dita：时尚电影可以留一点瑕疵
title.en: Dita Wants Fashion Films to Leave Room for Flaws

summary.zh: 在 ASVOFF 18，时尚评论人 Dita 与 C33 谈「未来复古」、过度修饰的影像，以及文字和视频里的同一种声音。
summary.en: At ASVOFF 18, fashion critic Dita talks to C33 about Future Vintage, overpolished images and keeping the same voice in print and on video.

body.zh:
在 ASVOFF 18，C33 问评委 Dita 如何理解「未来复古」。她没有从年代或造型谈起，而是把它与现实联系起来：回望过去，不等于复制过去。能够留下来的风格，需要回应当下的世界，也要让后来的人仍愿意参与其中。

她最厌倦的时尚电影套路，是把每个画面都打磨得过于完美。Dita 更喜欢作品保留一点瑕疵，就像略微晕开的睫毛膏：少一点修饰，画面反而有自己的味道。

从文章转向视频，她说自己的表达方式并不会因此改变，重要的是始终忠于自己的判断。问到这一届是否有令她意外的影片，她暂时没有透露片名。

[ASVOFF 18 官方网站](https://www.ashadedviewonfashionfilm.com/asvoff-18)
body.en:
Asked what Future Vintage means to her at ASVOFF 18, juror and fashion critic Dita did not begin with a decade or a silhouette. Looking back, she argued, should not amount to copying the past. Clothes and images that endure have something to say about the world around them—and give a later generation a reason to return.

The fashion-film habit she could do without is the pursuit of polish at any cost. Dita prefers an image with a little imperfection, comparing it to mascara that has smudged slightly. The flaw gives the work flavour.

Moving between writing and video does not, she said, require a different persona: she tries to stay true to her own point of view. As for a film that surprised her at this year’s festival, she was not ready to name it. 

[ASVOFF 18 official website](https://www.ashadedviewonfashionfilm.com/asvoff-18)

title.zh: Stephen Jones：时尚电影不一定是广告
title.en: Stephen Jones: A Fashion Film Needn’t Be an Ad

summary.zh: ASVOFF 18 评委会主席 Stephen Jones 谈时尚电影的多样性，以及为什么作品最终要与观众相遇。
summary.en: ASVOFF 18 jury president Stephen Jones talks to C33 about the range of fashion film and the audience that gives a work its life.

body.zh:
帽饰设计师 Stephen Jones 担任 ASVOFF 第 18 届评委会主席。C33 问他今年评片时关注什么，他首先提到作品之间的差异：有的接近时尚广告，有的讨论身心健康。时尚电影没有必须遵循的单一路径。

在他看来，最大的误解是以为时尚电影一定要推销一件商品。它也可以只从一种颜色或情绪出发，谈人与人之间的沟通；有时，它只需带来观看的愉悦。深意和轻松并不冲突。

给同时设计系列、同时拍片的年轻创作者，Jones 的回答落在观众身上。创作可以从很年轻时开始，也会随着时间改变。但一件作品能否真正成立，不能只由创作者自己决定：衣服要有人愿意穿，电影也要有人愿意看。

[ASVOFF 18 官方网站](https://www.ashadedviewonfashionfilm.com/asvoff-18)
body.en:
Stephen Jones, milliner and president of the ASVOFF 18 jury, began with the range of films he had seen. Some sit close to the fashion commercial; others address well-being. What interests him is that fashion film has no single prescribed form.

Its most persistent misconception, he told C33, is that it must sell something. A film can work through a colour or a mood, or through fashion as a way people communicate. It may carry a larger idea; it may simply be a pleasure to watch.

His advice to young designers making films alongside a collection brings the audience into the picture. Starting early matters, and the work will change. But creativity alone does not decide whether a garment or a film succeeds. People have to want to wear the clothes—and to watch the film.

[ASVOFF 18 official website](https://www.ashadedviewonfashionfilm.com/asvoff-18)

caption.en: Stephen Jones, president of the ASVOFF 18 jury.
